follow.label: Watch
follow.title: Watch an asset
follow.description: Without holding it: its price will show, and the day you buy some it becomes a position.

plan.label: Schedule a contribution
plan.title: Scheduled contribution
plan.description: A sum that moves from an account to an investment account at a regular interval, and buys there. The transfer and the buy are recorded together at each due payment.

operation.label: Declare an operation
operation.title: Operation
operation.description: What happens inside the account. Funding the account or taking money out of it is a transfer, declared in movements.

page.noAccount: No investment account. Create one in <link>Accounts</link>, then declare here what you hold in it.
page.firstBuy: Declare your first buy: the panel finds the ETF, share or crypto by its name, ISIN or provider.
page.valueHintUnpriced: cash + priced positions; {count} without a price
page.performanceMissing: a price is missing: the figure would be understated
page.performanceHint: dividends and fees included, against {amount} of contributions

detail.watchedNoPrice: watched, not held; no known price
detail.sessions: {count, plural, one {# known session} other {# known sessions}}
detail.unrealized: unrealized gain, dividends and fees excluded

search.otherVenues: {count, plural, one {# other listing of the same fund} other {# other listings of the same fund}}
search.unavailable: A listing without a readable price cannot be selected.
search.isinHint: Safest: paste the ISIN, shown by your bank. Otherwise, the price should match your statement.

forms.notQuoted: No source quotes it (real estate fund, unlisted shares, property)
forms.stopFollowingDescription: Nothing was declared on it, so there is nothing to lose. You can watch it again by searching for it.
forms.deleteDescription: {type} on {date}, {amount} in {account}. The position and average cost are recalculated without it.

plan.createNote: At each due payment, the transfer and the buy are recorded in one step: you will still enter the quantity bought, which only the execution price can tell.
plan.editNote: The correction applies to upcoming due payments. Contributions already confirmed keep their account and the asset bought: they record what happened.
